pages.text: Every player has their own Spectre Energy Buffer, which acts sort of like an Ender Chest for FE. By default, it can store 1,000,000 FE.$(br2)Energy can be inserted into a player's Buffer via the $(d)Spectre Energy Injector$(). Whoever placed the Injector is whose Buffer gets filled.
You cannot extract from the Injector. Instead, you'll have to use either a Spectre Coil or a $(l:irregular_implements:items/spectre_charger)Spectre Charger$(/l).
